newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat ends lower, March drops in liquidation.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat ends lower, March drops in liquidation.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures ended lower and March dropped back on liquidation ahead of Friday's first notice day for deliveries against the March contract, traders said.
KCBT wheat also drew pressure after beneficial moisture fell across a wide swath of the HRW wheat belt, and traders said there were forecasts for more rain this week.
Traders expressed different views about the likelihood of sizeable deliveries against the March contract.
"People are getting out of March amid threats of delivery," one KCBT trader said.
"People aren't so fearful about big deliveries as they are about weak cash values. The KC cash market is down 10 cents in the last two days," another said. "Nobody wants to own wheat."
KCBT wheat settled three to 11-3/4 cents per bushel lower, with March down 11-3/4 cents at $4.19-1/4. May lost 7-1/4 cents to close at $3.96.

Commission house Wolcott Lincoln was a featured player, selling 2.5 million of the July. Other large outright sellers off July included Cargill Investors and E D & F Man International, which each sold at least 1.2 million bushels.
